title: Aromatic Crispy Uruguayan Score-fat Empanadas
description: Delicate sweet empanadas infused with lemongrass and coconut milk. Perfect as a dessert or snack.

ingredients.name: Lemongrass stalks
ingredients.notes: white and light green parts only

instructions: Preheat the oven to 375°F (190°C). Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
In a food processor, combine gluten-free flour, sugar, and salt. Pulse until well combined.
Add softened butter to the flour mixture and process until a crumbly dough forms.
Add eggs to the dough and process until a cohesive ball forms. Wrap in plastic wrap and refrigerate for 30 minutes.
Trim lemongrass stalks to 6 inches long. Place them on a cutting board, cut-side up.
Score the surface of each lemongrass stalk with a sharp knife, creating a 1-inch deep grid pattern.
In a small bowl, whisk together coconut milk, sugar, and salt until dissolved.
Place a piece of dough on a lightly floured surface, roll out to a 1/8-inch thickness. Place a lemongrass stalk in the center of the dough.
Brush the edges of the dough with coconut milk mixture. Fold the dough over the lemongrass, pressing edges to seal.
Repeat with remaining dough and lemongrass. Place empanadas on prepared baking sheet, leaving 1 inch of space between each.
Brush tops with egg wash and sprinkle with confectioners' sugar, if desired.
Bake for 20-25 minutes or until golden brown. Cool on a wire rack for 10 minutes before serving.
